name: MetF
source:
MetF is a story about a strict and very religious mother who lives in a world where money dictates everything.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Amaziri/posts/metf-chapitre-2-48266617]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《MetF》讲述了一位严厉且极度虔诚的母亲，生活在一个金钱主宰一切的世界里的故事。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Amaziri/posts/metf-chapitre-2-48266617]Patreon[/url]]
